title: Extend exponential-character Rayleigh witnesses to complex directions
statement: For the FULL product-Poisson orthant, the coordinator extends f_u(x)=u^x to complex u using absolute squares: its energy/variance quotient is [(1/2)sum_r alpha_r |u^z_r-u^y_r|^2]/[1-exp(-sum_i c_i|u_i-1|^2)] when the variance is nonzero. Poisson absolute exponential moments keep these functions in the form domain. Real and imaginary parts split both energy and variance, so at least one nonconstant real part has a quotient no larger than the complex quotient. This enlarges the sufficient character-witness diagnostic; it does not establish necessity, a general constrained-class criterion, uniform tail coercivity or a total positive/zero decision.
